calls.title: Kat Byrne and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted the success of targeted event marketing led by Lindsay, which generated high-value leads and enhanced brand presence through participation in key events like the Pizza Tomorrow show and NRF conference. An account-based marketing strategy focused on approximately 50 high-value accounts was crucial, with customized content to improve outreach. The streamlined sales process, characterized by a small team structure with direct lead distribution, averaged 20 inbound leads weekly, with 2 qualifying as enterprise leads. Strong collaboration between marketing and sales leadership fostered better messaging and lead quality, empowering sales reps to independently source leads. Lindsay's organizational skills brought clarity to the marketing efforts, supporting self-sourced deals and improving overall company processes amid personnel changes and a lean team environment.
calls.keywords: Event-Based Marketing, Account-Based Marketing, Lead Generation, Trade Shows, Organizational Skills, Sales Collaboration
